assets.caption: EXHIBIT 7-40 Piping and Instrumentation Diagram for a Box-Type Furnace
assets.notes: Hand-drawn P&ID for box-type furnace F-720. Shows instrument bubbles (AT, TI, PI), STEAM-4" and SUPERHEAT STEAM-4" headers with SWING ELL, FLOW INDICATOR VISIBLE FROM GLOBE VALVE, AIR/STEAM 1-1/2" PG-5, FLOW REGULATING CONTROLLER, PRESSURE INDICATING CONTROLLER, FUEL GAS and PILOT GAS burner assemblies with BURNER MANAGEMENT PACKAGE, SAMPLE CONNECTION, and PRODUCT IN/OUT lines (0-272-G1, 0-292-G1). Caption block located at upper-right of figure.
